callouts.label: Safe Relationships
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents safe relationships.
callouts.description: Reliable caring relationships provide connection, perspective, and practical help.
callouts.ap_tip: Safety and trust matter more than relationship labels. Several supports create a stronger network.

callouts.label: Coping Skills
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents coping skills.
callouts.description: Flexible coping skills help manage emotion, stress, and difficult situations.
callouts.ap_tip: Skills can be learned and practiced. Coping should not replace changing harmful conditions.

callouts.label: Cultural Roots
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents cultural roots.
callouts.description: Culture, identity, language, spirituality, and community can strengthen meaning and belonging.
callouts.ap_tip: The person defines what is supportive. Cultural strengths can complement clinical care.

callouts.label: Sleep and Rest
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents sleep and rest.
callouts.description: Rest supports regulation, learning, immunity, and recovery.
callouts.ap_tip: Unequal schedules and environments affect sleep opportunity. Persistent sleep problems deserve support.

callouts.label: Movement
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents movement.
callouts.description: Movement can support mood, sleep, connection, and physical health.
callouts.ap_tip: Choose accessible enjoyable activity. Rest is part of movement planning.

callouts.label: Meaningful Goals
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents meaningful goals.
callouts.description: Purpose and realistic goals can organize effort and hope.
callouts.ap_tip: Goals may change after setbacks. Small steps count.

callouts.label: Healthcare
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents healthcare.
callouts.description: Accessible respectful healthcare supports prevention, treatment, and recovery.
callouts.ap_tip: A good care fit matters. Systems should reduce cost, language, and access barriers.

callouts.label: Peer Support
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents peer support.
callouts.description: Peers can offer understanding, companionship, and lived-experience wisdom.
callouts.ap_tip: Peers need boundaries and support too. Urgent risk requires adult or professional help.

callouts.label: School and Work Support
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents school and work support.
callouts.description: Flexible policies, accommodations, mentorship, and fair opportunity strengthen stability.
callouts.ap_tip: Performance is not the measure of human worth. Institutions share responsibility for access.

callouts.label: Stable Housing
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents stable housing.
callouts.description: Safe stable housing supports sleep, routines, care, and reduced stress.
callouts.ap_tip: Housing is a health condition. Community resources and policy matter.

callouts.label: Community Resources
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents community resources.
callouts.description: Food, transportation, recreation, care, and mutual aid expand practical options.
callouts.ap_tip: Resources should be accessible and culturally safe. Community members hold design expertise.

callouts.label: Hope and New Growth
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents hope and new growth.
callouts.description: Hope can coexist with grief, uncertainty, and slow progress.
callouts.ap_tip: Resilience is not invulnerability. People deserve support before, during, and after hardship.
